title: Out-of-distribution protein target — 3-arm observer study
summary: All three arms failed convergence under out-of-distribution stress. Multi-model disagreement correctly flagged the target as outside model distribution. Observer-only decision was safety-aligned: disagreement kept visible rather than resolved by majority vote.
findings: All 3 arms: trinity_failed_convergence — drift detected across all models
Promotion decision = KEEP_OBSERVER; minimum 50 samples required for promotion
Arm C: pLDDT mean = 76.52 (partially structured); Arms A and B: pLDDT = 40.0 (low confidence)
AlphaFold 2 and AlphaFold 3 outputs show low-confidence structural predictions
